Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

This is an Android role on Reddit’s Design System Team. The mission of the Design System Team is to deliver a cohesive, modern and accessible experience across all of Reddit’s platforms.

As a Senior Android engineer on the Design System Team, you will help evolve Reddit’s cross-platform design system and UI architecture that powers experiences across the company. You will build reusable components, improve platform capabilities, and help establish frontend patterns that enable product teams to ship high-quality experiences efficiently. This role has broad scope and impact, helping shape the future of frontend development at Reddit.

· Evolve Reddit’s cross-platform design system by expanding its capabilities and developing higher-level reusable components that accelerate product development while maintaining consistency and quality.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, designers, and engineers to ensure the design system and UI infrastructure effectively support real product needs.

· Improve performance at scale , contributing to Android architecture, rendering patterns, and performance-focused development practices that make performance a built-in feature of the platform.

· Advance accessibility across the platform , building accessible components, patterns, tooling, and documentation that help teams adopt accessibility best practices by default.

· Strengthen developer experience , contributing to shared tooling, documentation, and platform improvements that help engineers build reliable, consistent UI across Reddit’s products.

· 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional projects and delivering solutions with broad product impact.

· Experience building and maintaining shared UI infrastructure, such as design systems, component libraries, or frontend infrastructure used across multiple teams.

· Strong experience with modern Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with expertise in UI architecture, scalable component design, and performance optimization using tools such as Instruments.

· Familiarity with accessibility best practices and an interest in building components, tooling, or documentation that help teams ship accessible experiences by default.

· You embody Reddit’s core value of “Evolve” — you embrace ambiguity, seek feedback, and continuously improve your craft and the platform you help build.

· Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

· 401k with Employer Match

· Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

· Family Planning Support

· Gender-Affirming Care

· Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

· Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

· Generous Paid Parental Leave

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

16dd6cbd5a.t: About Niche Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally. About The Role Every year, millions of families start the school search process. Students wade through a sea of information and decisions to make, and unfortunately access to help hasn’t changed much in decades: it’s not super clear what your options are, and you might not feel confident that a school is right for you, or think you’ll be able to afford it. Niche is on a mission to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. Students need support choosing a school and paying for their education, schools want to find students who will thrive on their campus, and families need help supporting their students every step of the way. Niche helps ensure that it’s not just students already confident about college who get enrolled and can afford to attend. We’re looking for a Staff Design Systems Engineer to help define what modern design-to-code looks like at Niche , starting with overhauling our design system Expedite in partnership with two dedicated Product Engineers and the rest of the Product Design team. This is an exciting UX engineering role that requires both frontend and design fluency and reports to the Senior Director of Product Design. You’ll build and ship accessible, production-ready components, create and use AI tooling and LLM guidelines, and help shape new design workflows. You will work closely with designers and engineers to help shape the foundations, components, and patterns that product teams will rely on every day. Starting on day one, you will build your understanding of real product needs and then translate them into scalable systems, tools and processes, ensuring that they grow alongside the company. Your work will help unlock speed and quality across the Product org. This role is ideal for a builder who is eager for more ownership. The biggest opportunities: scope of ownership and freedom to experiment, design the future of product design and development at Niche , and overhaul our design systems with your vision, agentic automation, and a lot of love. You will sit at the intersection of craft, systems thinking, collaboration, and design excellence, with senior leadership support and guidance on delivering your dreams to production. The Design team is so excited for this role to be open and can’t wait to work with you! What You Will Do Design, refine and ship reusable and accessible components, tokens, and interaction patterns that enable teams to build consistent, high-quality experiences across web and mobile Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. With 2400+ customers in 70+ countries, strong product-market fit, and world-class investor support, we’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Design Systems Designer, you will define the foundations that make Harvey’s product coherent, scalable, and trustworthy as it grows in complexity. The design system is not just a library of components — it is the shared language between design, engineering, and AI that ensures consistency, quality, and confidence across every interaction. We're looking for someone who brings a strong brand sensibility to this work — a designer who thinks in systems but leads with craft.
In this role, you will operate as both a systems thinker and hands-on builder. Working in close partnership with frontend and platform engineering, you will design, ship, and evolve the components, patterns, and tokens that power the product. Your work will directly shape how quickly teams can build, how reliably the product behaves, and how confidently users interact with AI-driven workflows.

Define and evolve the core design system foundations, including components, patterns, and tokens that scale across complex, AI-powered experiences — with a sharp eye for brand cohesion and visual quality
Design, prototype, and ship production-ready system components in tight collaboration with frontend engineering
Partner directly with frontend and platform engineers to ensure system decisions translate cleanly into code, with shared ownership of quality, performance, and maintainability
Establish clear contribution, governance, and deprecation models that balance velocity with system integrity
Embed accessibility, responsiveness, and performance into the system by default
Document system usage and best practices in a way that is clear, practical, and trusted by product teams
Advocate for system adoption and consistency in product planning, design reviews, and execution
Anticipate future product and platform needs, evolving the system proactively as Harvey scales
What you have
8+ years of experience in product design, with significant ownership of design systems in complex product environments — ideally with a background in brand or visual design
An excellent portfolio demonstrating system-level thinking, component design, and real product impact
Deep understanding of component architecture, design tokens, and how design systems scale across teams
Proven experience partnering closely with frontend engineers to ship high-quality, production systems
Strong working knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
Ability to clearly articulate system decisions and tradeoffs to designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and bringing structure where it doesn’t yet exist
Why design systems matter at Harvey
Harvey is an AI-native product. As the system reasons, responds, and adapts in real time, the interface must remain consistent and legible. A strong design system ensures that complexity does not leak into the experience. It enables teams to move faster, reduces cognitive load for users, and builds trust in moments where clarity matters most.
